name: rendered-html-diff
description: A tiny CLI that renders a visual diff report for two static HTML documents.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js fixtures/before.html fixtures/after.html --out dist/demo.html
scripts.flow-demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js fixtures/app-flow-old.html fixtures/app-flow-new.html --out dist/app-flow-demo.html
